text_block_list.text:
While walking in front of the dorm,
I spotted Taiki Shuttle listlessly sweeping the grounds...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, I finally finished the entrance hall.
But I wonder what everyone else is doing right now――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Today's the day everyone in the dorm plays board games together, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I broke curfew,
so now I have to clean the dorms... *sigh*

Perhaps shocked by this, her spirits
remained low for quite some time...
